definition_zh: 结合文中所述变换实现轨道不平顺时频特征分析的方法。
usage_overview: 用于分析轨道不平顺的时频特征，通过结合小波分解与Wigner–Hough分析，识别不利不平顺区段的特征波长。

P002.title: A novel model for determining the amplitude-wavelength limits of track irregularities accompanied by a reliability assessment in railway vehicle-track dynamics
P002.label: Xu等（2017）

complete_examples.text: Then, the methodologies for determining the limits of track irregularities and achieving a reliability assessment are presented by introducing the probability density evolution method and development of a Wavelet-Wigner-Hough method.

To achieve these goals, the probability density evolution method (PDEM) will first be employed, and then, the track irregularity inversion model and the Wavelet-Wigner-Hough method will be further developed.
